description_en: Queries the configuration details of an incoming HTTP response header modification rule for a website
description_zh: 查询站点的修改HTTP入站响应头配置详情
name: GetHttpIncomingResponseHeaderModificationRule

parameters.help_en: The website ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can call the ListHttpIncomingResponseHeaderModificationRules operation to query the ID
parameters.name: config_id

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:

global: global configurations.
rule: rule configurations
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，取值范围：
global：全局配置。
rule：规则配置

ResponseHeaderModification.description_en: The configurations of modifying response headers. You can add, delete, or modify a response header
ResponseHeaderModification.description_zh: 修改响应头，支持添加、删除、修改三种操作方式

items.description_en: The configuration of modifying a response header

Name.description_en: The name of the response header

Operation.description_en:
The action. Valid values:

add: adds a response header.
del: deletes a response header.
modify: modifies a response header
Operation.description_zh:
操作方式。取值范围：

add：添加。
del：删除
modify：变更

Type.description_en:
The value type. Valid values:

static
dynamic
Type.description_zh:
值类型。取值范围：
static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式

Value.description_en: The value of the response header

Rule.description_en:
The content of the rule. A conditional expression is used to match a user request. You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configuration. Use cases:

true: Match all incoming requests.
Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq "video.example.com"): Match the specified request
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Valid values: You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configuration. Specifies whether to check the image used by the instance supports hot migration. Valid values:

on
off
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The order in which the rule is executed. A smaller value gives priority to the rule
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the configurations. You can use this parameter to specify a version of your website to apply the feature settings. By default, version 0 is used
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
